Thota Lakshmi Priyanka vs The State Of Telangana,And Another
on 5 December, 2024 
Author: P.Madhavi Devi
Bench: P.Madhavi Devi
 The Honourable Smt Justice P.Madhavi Devi
 W.P.No. 6642 of 2023
Order: 
In this writ petition, the petitioner is challenging the action of the respondents in issuing the impugned Memo No. 369/Rectt-pool-II/3/2022, dated 12.01.2023 rejecting the case of the petitioner to be considered as local candidate to Zone-VI Charminar to the post of Food Safety Officer in the Institute of Preventive Medicine Public Health Laboratories and Food (Health)
Administration under Notification No.6 of 2022, dated 21.07.2022 issued by the respondent No.2 as contrary to G.O.Ms.No.124, dated 30.08.2018 and as illegal, arbitrary, without jurisdiction and consequently to set aside the same and to treat the petitioner as a local candidate of Zone-VI Charminar as per the notification of 2022 and to pass such other order or orders.
2. This is the second round of litigation. The petitioner earlier had filed W.P.No.46474 of 2022 and in I.A.No.1 of 2022, of W.P.No.46474 of 2022 vide order dated 29.12.2022, this Court had directed the respondents to examine the petitioner's representations dated 12.12.2022 and 15.12.2022 with all the PMD,J relevant documents as enclosures and to consider the case of the petitioner for further selection process by treating the petitioner as local to Zone-VI (Charminar) as per Clause 7(2)(i) A of G.O.Ms.No.124, dated 30.08.2018. In accordance therewith, the respondents have passed the present impugned orders dated 12.01.2023 holding that since the petitioner has studied five consecutive years in two different zones i.e., two years in Zone-V (Yadadri) and the remaining years in Zone-VI (Charminar), it is not sufficient to treat her as local candidate to any of these two Zones and hence, her candidature cannot be considered as a local candidate of Zone-V or Zone-VI.
Challenging the same, the present writ petition has been filed. 
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that except for classes 1 and 2, which the petitioner has studied in the State of Andhra Pradesh due to the engagement of her father in Government Service in the combined State of Andhra Pradesh, the petitioner had completed her entire education in the State of Telangana and the details of her education are given at Page No.10 of the Writ Petition as under:
PMD,J Study Academic Mandal District Zone as per Class Year G.O.Ms.No.124 dt.30.08.2018.
 3rd 2002-03 Rajendra Ranga VI (Charminar)

1  Nagar Reddy  4th 2003-04 Rajendra Ranga VI (Charminar)
 Nagar Reddy  5th 2004-05 Nalgonda Nalgonda V (Yadadri)
 6th 2005-06 Nalgonda Nalgonda V (Yadadri)
 7th 2006-07 Nampally Hyderabad VI (Charminar)
 8th 2007-08 Nampally Hyderabad VI (Charminar)
 9th 2008-09 Nampally Hyderabad VI (Charminar)
 10th 2009-10 Nampally Hyderabad VI (Charminar)
 Degree 2012-15 Hyderabad Hyderabad VI (Charminar)
It is thus, submitted that the petitioner has completed her entire education in the State of Telangana and particularly in Zone-VI and therefore, the petitioner should be considered as a local of Zone-VI.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance upon the decision of this Court in W.P.No.28495 of 2022, dated 20.10.2022 and also in W.P.No.19038 of 2023, dated 20.09.2023 in support of his contentions that where a minimum qualification has been prescribed the Continuous study of four years for acquiring the said qualification has to be taken into consideration and not classes 1st to 7th as contended by the respondents.
PMD,J 5. Learned Standing Counsel for TSPSC, however, submitted that the orders of this Court in W.P.No.28495 of 2022 have been challenged by the respondents in W.A.No.778 of 2022 and in the said case the Division Bench has held that the petitioner would have to challenge the Presidential Order if they were aggrieved by the condition in G.O.Ms.No.124, dated 30.08.2018.
6. This Court finds that in W.P.No.19038 of 2023, this Court had already considered the decisions in W.P.No.28495 of 2022 and also W.A.No.778 of 2022 and vide orders dated 20.09.2023, this Court directed the respondents to consider the candidature of the petitioner therein as a local candidate of the respective Multi-Zone from where he has completed his graduation i.e., the minimum qualification prescribed for the said post. In this case also, since the petitioner has completed her graduation from Zone-VI (Charminar), she is entitled to be considered as a local candidate of Zone-VI (Charminar) as held by this Court in W.P.No.19038 of 2023.
7. This Court therefore, sets aside the impugned order dated 12.01.2023 and the respondents are directed to consider PMD,J the petitioner as a local candidate of Zone-VI (Charminar) and consider her case for appointment to the post of Food Safety Officer in the Institute of Preventive medicine Public Health Laboratories and Food (Health) Administration under Notification No.6 of 2022,
dated 21.07.2022, subject to her fulfilling all other conditions. 
8. Accordingly, this writ petition is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs.
